candidate_findings: Actual host/extracted handshake and FIO tests pass at modeled register-write delays of 1, 2, 5 and 13 system clocks. These are protocol stress tests, not a model of physical throughput.

A Cyclone V mixed-width FIFO partial-byte read after full exposed a transient wrapped zero used count. Credit now rejects zero used count unless write-domain empty agrees. Both vendor model families pass after correction.

Legacy and narrow fallback, unaligned and odd lengths, zero/full credits, coherent snapshots, counter wrap, dropped/corrupt data, reset, bad credit/count/digest/capability and no second batch on fault are covered.
Rolling 16-bit rotate/XOR checksum is not collision-proof; it is accompanied by accepted-word count and overflow/ready checks.
Ingest FIFO nominal 32 KiB, clean video queue 64 KiB, decoder/startup/video timing unchanged.
